$Comment: The in-game screen for the respec prices, on the owner menu (/zigadmin): one row per track whose respec has a price (its Respec.Cost, its own or its Parent's), each opening how many times that price is paid per level of the player's best level, saved straight into mods/ziggfreedcommon/tracks.json under that track's id as its Respec.PerLevel, beside the value it has without your file. A trainer's reset and the tree page's reset both charge it. What the price is paid in (Respec.Cost, an item or a wallet) stays in the file. Every word is a key of ziggfreedcommon.track.lang. Retune this screen (its place on the menu, a bound) in mods/ziggfreedcommon/owner-forms.json under the id Track_Respec.
Title: ziggfreedcommon.track.form.respec.title
